name: encoding-reflection-any-relay
description: A function of the program that passes its interface-typed parameter to an encoder is itself a destination for each argument a call passes for that parameter, and a composite literal such an argument writes reaches the types of the values it holds, so those types keep their exported fields. A function that stores its parameter and encodes nothing is no destination, so a field only the value handed to it carries is reported as written and never read.
